what: Byte-identical copies of eight scripts from the book repository, vendored so that Session 5's lab runs the chapter's own code rather than a paraphrase of it.

book_repo.head: 9cf89b540a636d80981d629a0bf665180cfce5c1
book_repo.head_subject: Rebuild main.pdf with the revised ch10 and ch11
book_repo.copied_from: the working tree, not a git checkout
book_repo.why_working_tree: code/ch13 and code/ch14 are STAGED RENAMES of the old code/ch14 and code/ch15 and the renumbering is still in progress. At HEAD these paths still hold the pre-renumbering content, so a `git show` or a checkout of 9cf89b5 would deliver different files. The working tree is the only place the intended ch13/ch14 content exists.
book_repo.written_to: nothing; the book repository is read-only for this lab

notes: There is no code/ch15 in the working tree: the old code/ch15 was renamed to code/ch14, and nothing took its place.
Neither code/ch13 nor code/ch14 carries a README. The old code/ch13/README.md is staged for deletion and describes the reinforcement-learning chapter that used to live there.

The docstrings inside these files still carry the PRE-RENAME chapter numbers. The four ch14 files announce themselves as companions to 'Chapter 15' and cite sections 15.x; the four ch13 files announce 'Chapter 14' and cite 14.x. human_llm_kappa.py also points at 'code/ch14/yin_vu_persico_kappa.py', which is now code/ch13/yin_vu_persico_kappa.py. The copies are byte-identical, so these stale references are preserved rather than corrected; chapters/chapter14.tex, by contrast, has already been renumbered and cites code/ch14/.
The .png figures that sit beside these scripts in the book repository were not copied: the lab draws its own figures, and the scripts regenerate theirs on demand.
_path_note: Absolute paths are written as <BOOK_REPO:Book1-AI-for-Econonomist> so that no private filesystem layout ships with the lab. The chapter-relative part of each path is the provenance that matters and is preserved verbatim.
